name: Ethereum
thesis: Ethereum trades at $2,504.73, up 0.77% on the day and 2.78% over the past 30 days, but it remains down 34.82% over the past year [1]. The price sits well below its one-year high of $4,292.85 and about 66% above its one-year low of $1,506.51, and the maximum one-year drawdown reached -63.14% [1]. Thirty-day volatility of 44.84% points to large price swings, so the recent modest gain looks like a tentative stabilisation within a longer downtrend rather than a confirmed reversal [1]. This data shows price behaviour only and says nothing about fundamentals, adoption or news [1].
